title: The Day of Two Loud Opinions
skyStory: The Gemini moon swells to sixty-five percent and splits into two voices, each convinced it is right. One says the snow is pretty. The other says the snow is in the way. They argue all afternoon over the long weekend Monday, and the sky is far too entertained to break it up. Saturn takes notes for a debate club.

reading: A holiday Monday in the middle of February is a small gift from the calendar, and the Tiger plans to unwrap it slowly. Two voices in your head will argue about how to spend it. One wants a project. One wants pancakes and a nap.

Let them both win. Morning for the project, afternoon for the nap. Around 2 pm you will get into a cheerful debate with someone about something unimportant, like the correct way to stack a woodpile. Argue passionately. Lose gracefully. The [[Two of Swords]] says some arguments exist purely for sport, and this is one.
joel.mission: Start a friendly, totally pointless debate today and make your case like it is a courtroom drama.
joel.omen: Two people pointing in opposite directions. It means both paths are good, so pick the funnier one.
joel.elementWhy: Gemini talks a mile a minute

reading: The Wood Rat enjoys a long weekend the way a cat enjoys a sunbeam: fully, with no apology. Today you will hear two sides of a small story from two different people, and you will be the only one who sees the whole picture.

Do not referee. Just smile and say, interesting. The Gemini moon loves a puzzle, and you are the one who can solve it without saying a word. Later, tell your own version of the story to someone who will appreciate it, with hand gestures for both sides. It will be a hit.
nancy.mission: Tell one story today doing two different voices for two different characters.
nancy.omen: A mirror or a window reflecting two of something. It means you can see both sides clearly today.
nancy.elementWhy: the calm centre of the chatter

together.text: Pick a silly question, like whether snowmen should wear hats or scarves, and take opposite sides. Argue by message all day with escalating seriousness. At sundown, swap sides and argue the other way. Gemini will award the trophy.
